messages.text: help me choose a CRM for our sales team
I’ll check the company context in the workspace, then compare CRM options against your team’s needs and budget.

How many people will use the CRM, how do you sell (for example, self-serve, outbound, or longer enterprise deals), and what’s your approximate budget?

What’s prompting the CRM search, and which tools or integrations must it work with?

messages.text: The workspace notes describe three users, Google Workspace email, and a $180/month budget with monthly billing preferred. The key requirement is preserving companies, locations, and shared contacts—and being able to export notes and quotes later. I’ll use those as the selection criteria.

Three seats; target maximum USD 180/month total, month-to-month preferred. Google Workspace email, shared spreadsheets and PDF quotes; three people handle sales. The founder, one salesperson and the support lead all work from a shared spreadsheet. A weekly call goes row by row through opportunities. Quotes live as PDF files linked from the sheet. Additional information about the sales model and trigger is not available.

That confirms the buying constraints. I’m comparing Pipedrive, Attio, and Capsule, with the spreadsheet as the baseline. I’ll distinguish documented features from anything that still needs a trial, especially relationship preservation, complete exports, and scoped assistant access.

Two findings affect the choice: Pipedrive needs care around contacts spanning locations, and Attio reserves custom objects for its Pro plan, which exceeds your budget. Capsule’s full export also leaves attachments for individual download. I’m checking the affordable data models and preparing a small import-and-export test using your sample pipeline.
